text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to prohibit southbound left turns to Downsview Avenue from the three driveways at No's. 2111-2113 Jane Street, between the hours of 6:00 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. These prohibitions will address concerns with transient motorists using the plaza's parking lot to bypass the northbound right-turn prohibition from Jane Street to Downsview Avenue that will operate during these time periods. An amendment to the existing northbound right-turn prohibition at Jane Street and Downsview Avenue is also being recommended to match the operating times of the driveway turn prohibitions.
